info.name: Autonomous AP APIs Chart of Accounts API
Creates a new chart of account segment

items.docs: Creates a new chart of account segment in AppZen and returns a uuid that uniquely identifies it. When there already exists a chart of account segment (segment_code), then the operation is an update (the `status` would be `UPDATED` in this case).

info.name: Returns a chart of account segment's details

params.name: uuid
params.description: Globally unique identifier for an uploaded document

items.docs: Returns the details of a chart of account segment by uuid

info.name: Returns all Chart of Accounts uuid that match the search criteria

items.docs: Returns a list of the Chart of Accounts uuids that match from-date and end-date
